en.title: Federal Transit Authority Allocates $233 Million for Rail Accessibility Upgrades
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Transit Administration has awarded $233 million to improve rail infrastructure accessibility, ensuring compliance with disability access standards. In related news, an AI-assisted accessibility tool has been released for public trial, while New Taipei addresses obstacles in its accessible social housing units. Community efforts continue, with a Fort Myers Beach fundraiser for a wheelchair-accessible van and recognition of a disability advocate’s Commonwealth Scholarship.

highlights.title: FTA issues $233M for rail accessibility upgrades
This incredible accessibility tool was coded with help from AI, and you can try it here
New Taipei accessible social housing units face obstacles, city government promises to resolve
Fort Myers Beach rallies around Cape Coral mom to help buy wheelchair accessible van
Misty Glam Company Founder Named Commonwealth Scholar

zh-TW.title: 聯邦交通管理局撥款2.33億美元升級鐵路無障礙設施
zh-TW.summary: 美國聯邦交通管理局已撥款2.33億美元，用於升級鐵路基礎設施以提升殘障人士無障礙性。同時，一項在AI協助下開發的無障礙工具現可公開試用，印第安納州高等教育委員會將審查雙學分課程的可及性。此外，殘障倡議組織Misty Glam創辦人獲英聯邦獎學金，藝術組織亦探討AI指引以平衡無障礙優勢與創作顧慮。
